title: rhus copallinum var. leucantha
intro: Rhus copallinum var. leucantha, commonly known as Smooth White Sumac, is a plant species belonging to the Anacardiaceae family, known for its medicinal properties and uses. The plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rhus copallinum var. leucantha include treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, as well as serving as a natural remedy for wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, tannins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and uses.
